services.title: Elderly Care – Vyenkatesh Ashram (Old Age Home)
services.tagline: Apno Se Door... Ek Apna Ghar...
services.shortDesc: A dignified, loving residential sanctuary for destitute, homeless, or neglected elderly citizens (Aai-Baba) providing food, clothing, shelter, affection, security, and healthcare.
services.fullDesc: Initiative 5.1 of SBBM Social Foundation: Operating under the emotional motto "Apno Se Door... Ek Apna Ghar...", Vyenkatesh Ashram at Anjikar Bagh, Mahuli provides a loving, secure, and permanent residential sanctuary for elderly individuals who have been abandoned, widowed, or lack familial care. Residents are treated not as inmates, but with filial reverence as "Aai-Baba". The facility ensures nutritious vegetarian meals, clean living quarters, daily medical checkups, emotional companionship, spiritual satsang, and dignified final rites in accordance with traditional values.
benefits: 24/7 safe, clean, and dignified residential accommodation with personal living space
Three nutritious home-cooked vegetarian meals, morning tea, and evening milk daily
Round-the-clock supportive attendants, routine vital checks, and visiting doctor consultations
Spiritual satsang, daily morning garden walks in Anjikar Bagh, and library access
Filial companionship, celebratory festivals, and dignified lifelong care
services.location: 434, Anjikar Bagh, Mansar Mahuli Road, Mahuli, Parseoni, Nagpur

services.title: Social Welfare & Essential Commodities Distribution
services.tagline: Direct Grassroots Relief for the Vulnerable
services.shortDesc: Direct distribution of dry rations, food grains, blankets, and essential relief kits to destitute families, widows, daily-wage laborers, and disaster-affected communities.
services.fullDesc: Initiative 5.2 of SBBM Social Foundation: Since December 2014, the foundation has prioritized direct grassroots relief for vulnerable families across Nagpur district and rural tehsils. Interventions include regular dry ration kit drives (containing wheat flour, rice, pulses, cooking oil, spices), winter blanket distributions for homeless citizens, festive cloth donations for children, and extensive emergency food and sanitization relief during disaster and pandemic emergencies.
benefits: Doorstep dry ration kit distribution (wheat flour, rice, dal, cooking oil, spices)
Winter relief drives providing warm blankets to homeless and street dwellers
Festive clothing and footwear distribution for underprivileged children
Emergency disaster and pandemic relief mobilization for daily-wage earners
Targeted support for destitute widows and physically challenged individuals
services.location: Nagpur District, Suburban Settlements & Rural Tehsils

services.title: Education & Computer Literacy Program
services.tagline: Empowering Underprivileged Youth with 21st-Century Digital Skills
services.shortDesc: Practical computer education, typing certification, digital literacy, and educational study material distribution for rural and underprivileged students.
services.fullDesc: Initiative 5.3 of SBBM Social Foundation: Believing firmly that "Education is Development", SBBM Social Foundation conducts targeted education support and digital literacy programs. The foundation operates computer literacy centers teaching rural students basic computer handling, Marathi/Hindi/English typing, MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), and internet navigation. Additionally, annual notebook distribution drives, textbook libraries, and career guidance workshops equip rural youth for higher education and competitive employment.
benefits: Hands-on computer fundamentals and typing certification (Marathi, Hindi, English)
Microsoft Office application training (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) for office readiness
Free annual notebook, textbook, and stationery kit distribution drives
Rural student library access and digital learning resources
Educational mentorship and career guidance seminars for youth

services.title: Child Welfare & Personality Development
services.tagline: Nurturing Moral Character, Creative Potential, and Child Rights
services.shortDesc: Holistic child development through annual summer camps, moral value education, talent workshops, child rights awareness, and nutritional support.
services.fullDesc: Initiative 5.4 of SBBM Social Foundation: Dedicated to the holistic flourishing of the next generation, this initiative organizes engaging summer camps, creative workshops (drawing, drama, elocution), and moral value education classes in rural and suburban Nagpur. The foundation actively conducts child safety and awareness workshops (including POCSO guidelines and child rights), provides nutritional support, and nurtures artistic and sports talents among economically backward children.
benefits: Annual summer camps featuring sports, yoga, arts, and creative expression
Value-based moral education and cultural heritage appreciation classes
Child safety, anti-bullying, and child rights awareness drives
School bag, uniform, and nutrition supplement distributions
Public speaking, elocution, and leadership grooming sessions
services.location: Nagpur District Schools, Community Centers & Mahuli Campus

services.title: Women’s Empowerment & Livelihood Development
services.tagline: Promoting Self-Reliance, Dignity, and Financial Independence
services.shortDesc: Mobilization and mentoring of Self-Help Groups (SHGs), vocational training in tailoring and crafts, financial literacy, and micro-enterprise development.
services.fullDesc: Initiative 5.5 of SBBM Social Foundation: Under the core pillar "Self-Reliance is the Foundation of an Empowered Society", the foundation mobilizes rural and semi-urban women into active Self-Help Groups (SHGs). We provide vocational training in tailoring, garment stitching, handicraft making, and local food processing (pickles, papads, spices). Through banking literacy, micro-savings facilitation, and direct market linkage, women are empowered to generate independent family income and build community leadership.
benefits: Mobilization and structured guidance of Mahila Bachat Gats (Self-Help Groups)
Professional tailoring, sewing, and handicraft training workshops
Financial literacy, micro-credit access, and bank linkage facilitation
Marketing support and exhibition stalls for home-made goods and handicrafts
Legal awareness sessions on women's rights and domestic welfare

services.title: Healthcare & Public Health Awareness
services.tagline: Preventive Medicine, Health Camps, and Community Wellbeing
services.shortDesc: Free diagnostic health camps, eye checkups, preventive medicine, hygiene drives, substance de-addiction, and chronic illness awareness.
services.fullDesc: Initiative 5.6 of SBBM Social Foundation: Good health is an essential prerequisite for community empowerment. The foundation organizes periodic free medical checkup camps in rural villages and urban slums, offering general health screening, eye checkups with free spectacles, blood pressure and diabetes monitoring, and basic medicine distribution. Extensive public awareness campaigns address substance de-addiction (tobacco/alcohol), menstrual hygiene, tuberculosis (TB) detection, and cancer prevention.
benefits: Free multi-specialty health checkups with qualified visiting medical practitioners
Free vision screening, eye examinations, and spectacles distribution
Tobacco and alcohol de-addiction counseling and youth awareness sessions
Community sanitation, clean water, and menstrual hygiene awareness drives
Chronic disease awareness (Hypertension, Diabetes, TB, and Cancer screening)
services.location: Village Camps & Slum Clusters across Nagpur District

services.title: Cow Protection & Animal Welfare – Shri Go Seva & Go Sanvardhan Kendra
services.tagline: Sanctuary for Indigenous Cattle & Sustainable Ecological Living
services.shortDesc: Compassionate sanctuary, veterinary care, nutritious fodder, and dignified lifetime shelter for abandoned, aging, and injured cows at Mahuli Centre.
services.fullDesc: Initiative 5.7 of SBBM Social Foundation: Located in the green environment of Anjikar Bagh, Mahuli, Shri Go Seva & Go Sanvardhan Kendra provides ethical shelter, green and dry fodder, freshwater, and veterinary care for indigenous cows. Beyond animal protection, the Kendra serves a vital therapeutic role: elderly ashram residents find companionship and peace interacting with the gentle cattle. Organic cow-dung and gomutra are utilized for natural composting, nourishing the surrounding fruit orchards without chemical pesticides.
benefits: Permanent humane shelter and daily care for indigenous abandoned or aged cows
Nutritious green grass, dry fodder, cattle feed, and clean drinking water
Periodic veterinary checkups, vaccination, and specialized medical treatments
Organic composting and biogas utilizing cow dung for eco-friendly farming
Therapeutic bovine interaction and spiritual Go-Pujan for ashram residents
services.location: Anjikar Bagh, Mansar Mahuli Road, Mahuli, Parseoni, Nagpur

services.title: Natural Therapy & Health Support – Aarogyam Prakritik Chikitsa Kendra
services.tagline: Drugless Healing, Naturopathy, and Holistic Rejuvenation (Inaugurated 6 Dec 2018)
services.shortDesc: Natural drugless therapy, dietetics, hydrotherapy, mud packs, yoga, and lifestyle disease management established on 6 December 2018.
services.fullDesc: Initiative 5.8 of SBBM Social Foundation: Formally inaugurated on 6 December 2018 at Anjikar Bagh, Mahuli, Aarogyam Prakritik Chikitsa Kendra is dedicated to promoting holistic healing without chemical drugs. Emphasizing the body's innate power to heal itself, the center offers free natural therapy consultations on weekends/Sundays. Therapies include hydrotherapy (hip baths, spinal baths), mud packs, sun therapy, diet counseling, acupressure, and therapeutic yoga/pranayama to manage joint pain, hypertension, digestive issues, and chronic fatigue.
benefits: Free Sunday naturopathy and holistic health consultation camps
Hydrotherapy, mud packs, steam therapy, and natural detox treatments
Personalized dietary guidelines based on natural wholesome foods
Daily therapeutic yoga, pranayama, and guided relaxation routines
Drugless management of lifestyle ailments (arthritis, diabetes, acidity, stress)
services.location: Anjikar Bagh, Mansar Mahuli Road, Mahuli, Parseoni, Nagpur

faqs.question: What is the procedure for admission to the Senior Care Sanctuary?
faqs.answer: Admission requires submitting an initial enquiry form or visiting our office. Because we maintain high care standards and limited capacity, accommodation availability, medical suitability, and admission formalities must be confirmed directly with the management (+91 98908 98081). Submitting an online enquiry does not guarantee immediate admission.

faqs.question: Where is SBBM Social Foundation located?
faqs.answer: The foundation centre is located at 434, Anjikar Bagh, Mansar Mahuli Road, Village/Post Mahuli, Tehsil Parseoni, District Nagpur, Maharashtra – 441105. The Foundation Head Office is located at C/o Ashvin V. Anjikar, Anjikar House, Panchpaoli, Timki Chimabai Peth, Nagpur – 440018.

faqs.question: Is SBBM Social Foundation a registered organization?
faqs.answer: Yes, SBBM Social Foundation Society was established in 2015 and is officially registered under the Societies Registration Act (Reg No: 332-15-Nag). It operates as a charitable social welfare society.

faqs.question: Can families and well-wishers visit the foundation centre?
faqs.answer: Yes, family visits and community well-wishers are welcomed. Prior notification via telephone (+91 98908 98081) is requested to ensure resident rest hours and daily schedules are respected.

faqs.question: How can I support the foundation through donations or seva?
faqs.answer: You can support us through direct bank transfer, contributing daily provisions (grains, oil, groceries), medicines, blankets, or green fodder for our Go-Seva Kendra cows. Official receipts are issued for all contributions. Contact our office directly for verified bank account details.

faqs.question: How can I become a volunteer or member?
faqs.answer: You can submit an online volunteer or membership application through our website. Our team will contact you to discuss your interests, availability, and verify membership eligibility.
